difficulty_reason: For simplicial sets U subset V differing by one nondegenerate simplex x in V_n with all higher new simplices degenerate, show Hom(V,K)_0 -> Hom(U,K)_0 is a covering: for n = 0, V = U coprod Delta[0] and the map is Hom(U,K)_0 x K_0 -> Hom(U,K)_0, a covering by lemma-covering-permanence; in general let a : Delta[n] -> V be the map of x and b its restriction to the boundary; by simplicial-lemma-glue-simplex V = U coprod_{partial Delta[n]} Delta[n], so by simplicial-lemma-hom-from-coprod the square with Hom(V,K)_0 -> Hom(U,K)_0 over Hom(Delta[n],K)_0 -> Hom(partial Delta[n],K)_0 is a fibre product square; by simplicial-lemma-cosk-shriek the bottom arrow identifies with K_n -> (cosk_{n-1} sk_{n-1} K)_n, a covering by the definition of a hypercovering.
